name: 时间抖动检测
algorithm: Temporal Jitter Detection — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method detects temporal jitter for video deepfake detection:

1. **Jitter测量**: Sub-pixel temporal jitter is measured across the video — the high-frequency component of point trajectories after removing the smooth (intentional) motion component. Jitter represents frame-to-frame positional noise.

2. **JitterSource分类**: Different jitter sources produce different characteristics: (a) camera sensor noise → spatially uniform, small amplitude, (b) compression jitter → block-aligned, (c) deepfake generation jitter → content-dependent, potentially larger amplitude. The method classifies detected jitter by source.

3. **人脸-BackgroundJitter比较**: In authentic video, jitter characteristics are uniform across the frame (same camera). The method compares jitter in face regions vs. background. Deepfakes typically show elevated jitter in the generated face — the generator introduces positional uncertainty that differs from the camera's native noise.

4. **Jitter时间Structure**: Camera jitter has flat temporal spectrum (white noise). Generation jitter may show characteristic temporal structure — periodicity from the generation pipeline, correlation patterns from autoregressive generation, or specific spectral color from the training process.

5. **JitterAmplitude评估**: The amplitude of detected jitter is compared against expected values for the estimated camera system. Excessive jitter (beyond what the camera would produce) in face regions indicates generation artifacts. The method quantifies excess jitter as a deepfake indicator.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through temporal jitter detection analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
Amerini, I. et al. (2019). Deepfake Video Detection through Optical Flow based CNN. ICCV Workshop.
